scope: Workspace Sync 0.4.0 and its consuming Automations storage contract
discovery: All tracked source files were scanned for status/phase/state, optional fields, counters, timestamps, leases, retries, provider effects and ordering; migration readers/writers are inventoried in the consuming app. Inventory entries group one authoritative model, not filename keywords.

machines.oldRepresentation: Google provider booleans and duplicate catalog model in Automations
machines.authoritativeReplacement: AuthoritativeGoogleDirectoryUserStateSchema and AuthorityIdentitySchema; one exported identity-authority module
machines.recovery: A deletion retains immutable provider links through identity history; missing authority remains incomplete.

machines.oldRepresentation: Unlinked/verified/conflicting identity links
machines.authoritativeReplacement: GitHubIdentityStateSchema and exhaustive authority transition results
guards: immutable provider ID and canonical login
machines.recovery: Conflicting or missing links never authorize destructive account changes.

machines.oldRepresentation: Audit, kill switch, bounded automatic, and unexposed approved-apply path with redundant fixed fields
machines.authoritativeReplacement: IdentityProvisioningExecutionPolicySchema: audit-only | kill-switch-engaged(reason) | bounded-automatic-deprovision
machines.recovery: Unknown policy variants fail validation; adding a supported policy requires exhaustive execution handling.

machines.oldRepresentation: Unused approval schema, approval persistence, expiry and claim APIs
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Deleted; Automations migration 0088 checks that approvals are empty before dropping their table
guards: Migration aborts for unexpected approval or run evidence
machines.recovery: No caller in the consuming application; production preflight found zero rows. This never replaces Workspace signed parent approvals.

machines.oldRepresentation: Write-only planned/applying/completed/failed columns with no run lifecycle producer
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Immutable run identity (authority revision, plan hash, creation time), with unique canonical run ID
machines.recovery: A duplicate plan reuses its canonical identity; operations own execution evidence.

machines.oldRepresentation: Pending/claimed/succeeded with every provider error returned to pending
machines.authoritativeReplacement: pending -> claimed -> dispatching -> succeeded; dispatching -> uncertain -> recovering -> succeeded or uncertain. Fresh/recovery claims are a discriminated union.
guards: SQL state invariants and transition triggers
machines.recovery: Persist dispatch before the exact provider call. Failed prewrite checks return to pending. Uncertain/crashed dispatches use read-only connector.recover; no new DELETE is issued. Migration treats all legacy attempted pending/claimed records as uncertain.

machines.oldRepresentation: Optional errors and implicit success flags across Google, GitHub and Slack writes
machines.authoritativeReplacement: ProviderWriteOutcome acknowledged | uncertain(error); ChannelKickOutcome for Slack-specific transport errors
guards: existing fresh authority, identity budgets, snapshots, leases and exact postconditions remain mandatory
machines.recovery: Acknowledgement is not verification. A thrown request is not proof of no effect. Readback can establish the required postcondition; failed readback preserves uncertainty.

machines.oldRepresentation: Boolean operationFailed, possibly undefined error, and non-null asserted result
machines.authoritativeReplacement: ResourceLeaseAcquisition and OperationOutcome<Result> discriminated unions
machines.recovery: Release failure cannot mask the original operation error; a synchronous throw also releases the lease. Expired generations cannot release a replacement owner.

machines.oldRepresentation: Durable pending/claimed/completed/terminal_failed records
machines.authoritativeReplacement: One D1 repository owns transitions; typed input and claimed-event DTOs validate required per-command data
machines.recovery: Expired claims are reclaimed; equivalent older events complete only from current verified authority. Deleted authority beyond the provider retention window remains terminal_failed, never successful.

machines.oldRepresentation: Started run plus nullable manifest and completion metadata
machines.authoritativeReplacement: One store enforces started -> manifest capture -> exact completed or failed transitions; GoogleDirectoryFullReconciliationResult is a closed result union
machines.recovery: An incomplete event prefix cannot mark a full run healthy; crashes remain visibly started/failed. No provider mutation is permitted by its audit policy.

machines.oldRepresentation: Active/stopped rows and expiry
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Typed create/renew actions and ready/blocked/disabled plans; active-channel-only DTOs
machines.recovery: New channels activate before old ones stop. A missing acknowledgement does not grant notification authority.

machines.oldRepresentation: String status branches with fallback assuming the only remaining status was claimed
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Exhaustive status switch and acquired(lease) | duplicate(outcome) | in-flight(retryAfterSeconds) result union
machines.recovery: Failed/expired admissions can be retried; terminal enqueued/ignored receipts deduplicate repeated events. New statuses require compile-time exhaustive handling.

machines.oldRepresentation: Retained links and deletion tombstone lifetime
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Typed immutable identity snapshots and bounded tombstone commands
machines.recovery: Old identity evidence never becomes new active authority; missing snapshots fail closed.

machines.oldRepresentation: Attempt and resolution histories consolidated in 0.3.0
machines.authoritativeReplacement: One immutable attempt with at most one exact terminal resolution; typed attestation/authority transition contracts
machines.recovery: An unresolved write remains fenced across retries and deployments; a lack of acknowledgement never settles it.

machines.oldRepresentation: Consumed permanent budget alongside expiring resource leases
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Immutable one-subject reservation, separately typed from resource lease ownership
machines.recovery: A crash consumes the reservation; no reset or compensation invents a second authorized identity.

machines.oldRepresentation: Membership provenance and removal control flow
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Typed addition/removal plans, exact authority guards and mandatory readback; explicit kick outcomes
machines.recovery: Manual/unowned membership is retained. Unknown writes require authoritative readback; failed readback retains audit evidence.

machines.oldRepresentation: Separate access/workspace indexes consolidated in 0.3.0
machines.authoritativeReplacement: One namespaced Slack history/message store with typed cursor/revision operations
machines.recovery: Incomplete pages retain their cursor and cannot imply complete history.

machines.oldRepresentation: Provider captures, incomplete inventories and authority freshness
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Strict runtime authority schemas, ready/blocked observations and exact snapshot fingerprints
machines.recovery: Provider read failure remains incomplete; no email guess repairs missing deletion evidence.

machines.oldRepresentation: Shared expiring fence records
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Typed deployment lease commands with generation/owner/version guards
machines.recovery: A stale deployment cannot authorize a provider write.

machines.oldRepresentation: Provider account facts and eligibility decisions
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Closed satisfied/blocked/provision/deprovision and readiness/plan unions; provider observations distinguish absent, present, ambiguous and unsupported
machines.recovery: Unsupported or ambiguous observations remain blocked. Audit plans authorize no execution.

machines.oldRepresentation: Retry counters, response limits, and a completion boolean controlling stream cleanup
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Bounded retry loops and explicit exception/resource lifetime; completion flag removed
machines.recovery: Write requests are never assumed absent after timeout; response cleanup preserves original errors.

justifiedRepresentationExceptions.reason: D1 stores one constrained row per entity. Runtime code consumes only validated state-specific command DTOs/claims, and every mutation is conditional on the authoritative current SQL state and version. Duplicating full database rows as a second in-memory state store would introduce another source of truth.

Google/Slack/GitHub wire data and nullable pagination tokens are external contracts. Validate them at the boundary and project authority/observation/plan unions before decisions. A single optional cursor or optional resource is an Option with no contradictory field combinations; bounded lexical loops own its lifetime.

Static identity IDs, names, policy metadata, chart tree traversal, and feature configuration have no durable transition lifecycle. Validate one immutable process policy; configuration readiness is represented by explicit ready/blocked/disabled results.
